baselineDisplay.title: 惩罚势利的售货员
baselineDisplay.text:
【故事复现】惩罚势利的售货员
• Step 1: Listen and answer the question.
第一步：听 Freya 慢速朗读的故事，回答下列问题。
Question: Did the woman get what she wanted?
问题：这个女人得到她想要的吗？
Answer: Yes, she did.
• 词汇准备
• Madam (对妇女的尊称)太太，夫人
• jeans 牛仔裤
• hesitate 犹豫，迟缓
• serve 接待(顾客)
• scornfully 轻蔑地
• punish 惩罚
• fur 裘皮
• eager 热切的，热情的
• Step 2: Intensive reading.
第二步：故事精读。
A woman in jeans stood at the window of an expensive shop.
一位穿着牛仔裤的妇女站在一家高档商店的橱窗前。
Though she hesitated for a moment, she finally went in and asked to see a dress that was in the window.
她虽然犹豫了片刻，但终于还是走进了商店，要求把陈列在橱窗里的一件衣服拿给她看。
The assistant who served her did not like the way she was dressed. Glancing at her scornfully, he told her that the dress was sold.
接待她的售货员不喜欢她的那副打扮，轻蔑地看了她一眼后，便告诉她那件衣服已经卖出去了。
The woman walked out of the shop angrily and decided to punish the assistant next day.
这位妇女怒气冲冲地走出了商店，决定第二天教训一下那个售货员。
She returned to the shop the following morning dressed in a fur coat, with a handbag in one hand and a long umbrella in the other.
第二天上午，她又来到这家商店，穿了一件裘皮大衣，一只手拎着一只手提包，另一只手拿着一把长柄伞。
After seeking out the rude assistant, she asked for the same dress. Not realizing who she was, the assistant was eager to serve her this time.
找到那个无礼的售货员后，她还要看昨天的那件衣服。那个售货员没有认出她是谁，这一回接待她的态度非常殷勤。
With great difficulty, he climbed into the shop window to get the dress. As soon as she saw it, the woman said she did not like it.
费了好大劲儿，他爬进橱窗去取那件衣服。这位妇女对那件衣服只看一眼，就说不喜欢。
She enjoyed herself making the assistant bring almost everything in the window before finally buying the dress she had first asked for.
她开心地迫使那位售货员把橱窗里几乎所有的东西都拿了出来，最后才买下了她最先要看的那一件。
• Step 3: Listen again and answer the questions.
第三步：再听一遍，回答下列问题。
1 Did the woman in jeans hesitate for a moment or not? Did she enter an expensive shop or not? What did she ask to see? (Though... and)
2 What did an assistant tell her? When did the woman return? Was she dressed in a fur coat or not? (On being told by)
3 What was the assistant eager to do this time?
4 What did she make him bring her? What did the woman finally buy? (After making)
Answer: Though the woman in jeans hesitated for a moment, she entered an expensive shop and asked to see a dress that was in the window. On being told by an assistant that the dress was sold, the woman returned the following morning dressed in a fur coat. The assistant was eager to serve her this time. After making him bring her almost everything in the window, the woman finally bought the dress she had first asked for.
• Exercise: Sentence structure and vocabulary.
课外练习：句型及词汇训练。
1 The assistant refused to help the woman because he ________.
(a) didn't approve of the way she was dressed
(b) approved of the way she was dressed
(c) liked the way she was dressed
(d) noticed the way she was dressed
2 The woman got her revenge by ________.
(a) buying a dress
(b) putting the assistant to a lot of trouble
(c) complaining to the manager
(d) asking for something in the window
3 The woman stood at the window. She stood ________ it.
(a) in front
(b) in front of
(c) front
(d) ahead of
4 The assistant her did not like the way she was dressed.
(a) served
(b) serving
(c) who serving
(d) was serving
5 After ________ out the rude assistant she asked for the same dress.
(a) she was seeking
(b) she had sought
(c) sought
(d) when she sought
6 _________ who she was, the assistant was eager to serve her this time.
(a) Not to realize
(b) Without to realize
(c) Except realizing
(d) Without realizing
7 She bought the dress ________ she had first asked for.
(a) who
(b) what
(c) that
(d) whom
8 He glanced at her scornfully. He _______ her.
(a) mocked
(b) teased
(c) laughed at
(d) despised
9 She returned the following day. She returned the day _______.
(a) other
(b) next
(c) after
(d) else
10 She sought out the rude assistant. He had been ________ polite.
(a) un-
(b) im-
(c) in-
(d) dis-
11 He was eager to serve her. He was ________ to serve her.
(a) prompt
(b) fast
(c) nervous
(d) anxious
12 He brought almost everything in the window. He brought ________ everything.
(a) nearly
(b) scarcely
(c) hardly
(d) already

第四十六单元【语法点拨】 关系代词的选择（上）
▶ 学习定语从句的关键在于正确运用关系代词，而关系代词的选择取决于以下几个因素：
1. 定语从句修饰或说明的先行词的意义，即先行词是指人还是指物
2. 关系代词在从句中的句法功能，即关系代词是作定语从句的主语还是宾语,还是句子的其他成分。
3. 定语从句与先行词的关系，即定语从句是限制性定语从句还是非限制性的定语从句。
下面讨论在定语从句中，如何正确选择关系代词及其用法比较。
▶ 关系代词的选择
▪ that 与 who 的用法比较：
关系代词 that 与 who 都可以表示人，但 that 不可引导非限制性定语从句。一般而言，that 多用于口语或非正式文体, who 多用于正式文体。两者在限制性定语从句中的用法有以下区别：
(1)在 everybody, anybody, everyone, anyone 等词之后只能用关系代词 who。
• Is there anyone who can answer this question? 有谁能回答这个问题吗?
(2)当先行词被一个最高级形容词或限定词如 any, first, last, only 等修饰时，用 that 而不用 who。
• He is the greatest composer that has ever lived. 他是当代最伟大的作曲家。
• You are the only person that can help us. 你是唯一能帮助我们的人。
(3)当先行词是指人、指物的两个并列名词时用 that 而不用 who。
• He spoke of the people and the things that he had seen.
他谈到了他看到的人和事。
(4)关系代词作表语时，只能用 that, that 能指人、指物，但往往被省略。
• He’s changed. He is not the man (that) he was.
他变了，他不是以前的那个人了。
(5)当定语从句为 there be 结构时，在从句作主语的关系代词只能是 that, that 常可省略。
• He is supposed to be a gifted composer that there has ever been.
他被认为是一位天才的作曲家。
(6)当先行词为 those 或 all 指示人，通常用 who。
• Those who are in favor of the proposal please raise your hands.
赞成提案者请举手。
• He commands the respect of all who know him well.
所有了解他的人都对他非常尊敬。
(7)当先行词特指意义较强时通常用 who。
• The man who was killed in the car accident yesterday was his brother.
昨天在车祸中死去的那个人是他的兄弟。
(8)当先行词是 who 时，而且后面跟定语从句时，只能用 that。
• Who that had been there for but a few hours could ever forget?
只要在那儿呆过几小时的人有谁能忘记呢?
(9)在限制性定语从句中，有时为了明确所指对象避免歧义，必须根据句子的意思来选择关系代词。如果指人的先行词被其他成分隔开时，通常用 who。
• There is only one student in the school who I must see.
这个学校里只有一个学生我必须见到。
• She is the only person in the office who knows about the matter.
她是办公室里唯一知道这件事的人。
(10)在正式文体中，人称代词 he 可以用作先行词表示类指，但复数人称代词 they 则不能。此外，he 后面的定语从句中的引导词可以是 who 或 that。
• He who/that breaks this law deserves fine. 违反本法者应予罚款。
▪ that 与 which 的用法比较:
(1) which 和 that 用于事物，可以互换使用；which 作主语时，比 that 更正式。
• This is the novel which/ that caused a great sensation.
这就是曾引起巨大轰动的那部小说。
(2)当先行词为 all, everything, nothing, anything, something, little, much, a few 等不定代词时，用 that 而不用 which。
• That’s all that I can do for you. 这就是我能为你所做的一切。
• There’s no much that can be done now. 现在没有很多可做的了。
• All that glitters is not gold. 闪光的未必都是金子。
(3)先行词有形容词最高级形式、序数词、限定词(some, any, no, every, little few, much, all 等)或 only, very 等词修饰时，通常用 that。
• This is the most exciting film that I’ve ever seen.
这是我看过的最激动人心的影片。
• She picked up all the apples that had fallen from the tree.
她把树上掉下来的苹果都捡了起来。
(4)在“the same...as”结构中，关系代词 that 可以代替 as，而不能用 which。
• You have made the same mistake that you made last time.
你犯了和你上次所犯同样的错误。
(5)在“it is...”强调结构中，that 作主语时近似关系代词，不可用 which。
• It is the deed that is important, not the words. 重要的是行,而不是言。
• It is Jack that makes the decisions here. 在这里做出决定的是杰克。
(6)先行词为 that 时，只能用 which。
• I use the word not in the present depreciatory sense, but in that which was held in the nineteenth century.
我用这个词不是用它当今的贬义，而是取其 19 世纪的意义。
(7)当关系代词在从句中作表语时，只能用 that。
• Computers are not the all-purpose instruments that some people say they are.
计算机并不是有些人所说的那种万能工具。
(8)当定语从句为“there be”结构时，作从句主语的关系代词只能用 that, that 常可省略。
• I know the difference that there is between you.
我知道你们之间存在的分歧。

第四十六单元【语法点拨】 关系代词的选择（上）
▶ 学习定语从句的关键在于正确运用关系代词，而关系代词的选择取决于以下几个因素：
1. 定语从句修饰或说明的先行词的意义，即先行词是指人还是指物
2. 关系代词在从句中的句法功能，即关系代词是作定语从句的主语还是宾语,还是句子的其他成分。
3. 定语从句与先行词的关系，即定语从句是限制性定语从句还是非限制性的定语从句。
下面讨论在定语从句中，如何正确选择关系代词及其用法比较。
▶ 关系代词的选择
▪ that 与 who 的用法比较：
that 与 who 都可以指人。who 可用于限制性和非限制性定语从句，that 只能用于限制性定语从句；两者都不只限于某一种文体。以下区分必须遵守的结构规则与常见用法倾向。
(1)在 everybody、anybody、everyone、anyone 等指人的词之后，常用 who，也可以使用 that。
• Is there anyone who can answer this question? 有谁能回答这个问题吗?
(2)先行词受最高级、序数词或 only 等修饰时，常用 that；指人时 who 也可用，不能一概排除。
• He is the greatest composer that has ever lived. 他是有史以来最伟大的作曲家。
• You are the only person that can help us. 你是唯一能帮助我们的人。
(3)当先行词是指人、指物的两个并列名词时用 that 而不用 who。
• He spoke of the people and the things that he had seen.
他谈到了他看到的人和事。
(4)关系词表示从句中的表语成分时，限制性定语从句常用 that，也常省略。
• He’s changed. He is not the man (that) he was.
他变了，他不是以前的那个人了。
(5)there be 结构的限制性定语从句可用 that，也常省略关系词；there 已占据形式主语位置。不能因此规定这类从句绝对不能用其他适当的关系词。
• He is thought to be the most gifted composer (that) there has ever been.
人们认为他是有史以来最有天赋的作曲家。
(6)当先行词为 those 或 all 指人，通常用 who。
• Those who are in favor of the proposal please raise your hands.
赞成提案者请举手。
• He commands the respect of all who know him well.
所有了解他的人都对他非常尊敬。
(7)指人时 who 很常见；先行词是否特指并非决定只能用 who 的规则。
• The man who was killed in the car accident yesterday was his brother.
昨天在车祸中死去的那个人是他的兄弟。
(8)疑问词 who 后再接定语从句时，常用 that 避免连续重复 who。
• Who that had been there for but a few hours could ever forget?
只要在那儿呆过几小时的人有谁能忘记呢?
(9)关系词与先行词隔开时，应特别注意指代清晰。指人时用 who 可以帮助读者辨认，下面两例也说明 only 后并非只能用 that。
• There is only one student in the school who I must see.
这个学校里只有一个学生我必须见到。
• She is the only person in the office who knows about the matter.
她是办公室里唯一知道这件事的人。
(10)He who ... 可用于格言式或较正式的表达，表示“……的人”；现代英语常改用 anyone who 或 those who。They who ... 也有古旧、文学性的用法，不能说在所有语境中都不存在。
• He who/that breaks this law deserves a fine. 违反本法者应予罚款。
▪ that 与 which 的用法比较:
(1)指事物的限制性定语从句通常可用 which 或 that；非限制性定语从句及介词紧接关系词的结构不能这样互换。
• This is the novel which/ that caused a great sensation.
这就是曾引起巨大轰动的那部小说。
(2)all、everything、nothing、anything 等表示事物的不定代词后通常用 that，但不要把这种倾向扩展为所有不定数量表达之后都绝对禁止 which。
• That’s all that I can do for you. 这就是我能为你所做的一切。
• There’s not much that can be done now. 现在没有很多可做的了。
• All that glitters is not gold. 闪光的未必都是金子。
(3)先行词有形容词最高级形式、序数词、限定词(some, any, no, every, little, few, much, all 等)或 only, very 等词修饰时，通常用 that。
• This is the most exciting film that I’ve ever seen.
这是我看过的最激动人心的影片。
• She picked up all the apples that had fallen from the tree.
她把树上掉下来的苹果都捡了起来。
(4)the same 后可用 that 引导定语从句，指与先前提及相同的人或事物；也有 the same ... as 结构，表达比较或相同性质，不能在所有句子里机械替换。
• You have made the same mistake that you made last time.
你犯了和你上次所犯同样的错误。
(5)It is ... that ... 强调句用 that 连接被强调部分和后面的分句。强调人时也常用 who；强调事物时不以 which 代替 that。
• It is the deed that is important, not the words. 重要的是行,而不是言。
• It is Jack that makes the decisions here. 在这里做出决定的是杰克。
(6)当先行词为指示代词 that 时，通常接 which，避免 that that 连用。
• I use the word not in the present depreciatory sense, but in that which was held in the nineteenth century.
我用这个词不是用它当今的贬义，而是取其 19 世纪的意义。
(7)关系词表示从句中的表语成分时，限制性定语从句常用 that，也可省略。
• Computers are not the all-purpose instruments that some people say they are.
计算机并不是有些人所说的那种万能工具。
(8)在 there be 结构的限制性定语从句中，that 常可省略；不能概括为关系词在这类结构中一律只能用 that。
• I know the difference that there is between you.
我知道你们之间存在的分歧。
